startScanYaw.description: Initial yaw angle for the scan sweep, in degrees—measured clockwise from the reference set by `relType` (true north if `North`, the current leg’s heading if `FlightLeg`). The gimbal begins rotating from this angle toward `finishScanYaw`.

finishScanYaw.description: Final yaw angle for the scan sweep, in degrees—measured clockwise from the same `relType` reference; the gimbal rotates from `startScanYaw` to this angle (respecting the specified sweep `direction`).

startDistance.description: Initial horizontal distance from the drone to the scan target, in meters; defines the radius at which the sweep begins.

finishDistance.description: Final horizontal distance to the scan target, in meters; the sweep ends at this radius (interpolated from `startDistance`).

duration_ms.description: The scan duration in milliseconds; must be 0 or a positive value.

direction.description: Rotation direction for the scan sweep—choose **`clockwise`** or **`counterClockwise`**.

relType.description: Reference frame for yaw angles: `North` (true north), `Body` (drone body heading), or `FlightLeg` (direction of the current leg).

isAiAction.description: When `true`, the captured frame is sent to the AI module specified by `aiModule` for analysis.

aiModule.description: AI module to use for analysis: `Traffic` for vehicle counting/occupancy, `License Plate` for plate recognition, or `Prompt Based` for custom prompt-driven detection.

trafficType.description: Sub-mode for the `Traffic` AI module: `Traffic Count` counts vehicles, `Occupancy` measures area occupancy.

selectedCube.description: References a pre-configured detection cube for AI analysis.

prompt.description: Free-text prompt sent to the `Prompt Based` AI module describing what to detect or analyze.

detectionType.description: Detection strategy for the `Prompt Based` AI module: `detect` finds objects, `query` answers questions about the scene, `point` identifies a specific location.

alertAction.description: When `true`, triggers an alert if the AI module detects a match.

watchObjects.description: List of object labels the AI module should watch for (e.g. `["person", "vehicle"]`).
